comment.body:
The pasted log is useful: it is from the per-user 0.81.0 installer, and it fails creating the bundle cache before MSI runs. That differs from the later participant whose existing MSI cache was missing.
1. Which installer filename/version produced your current failing attempt?
2. Can your normal account access the per-user Package Cache parent, and does its Security information show an unexpected owner or explicit deny? Please inspect without changing permissions and omit account names.
Do not delete Package Cache or grant broad permissions; the missing-MSI workaround is not established as applicable to this access-denied case.
